An '''ovipositor''' was an anatomical structure used by certain [[Species/Legends|species]] to facilitate in the laying of [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]. The [[Olabrian trichoid]]s possessed ovipositors, as did the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Karina the Great/Legends|Karina the Great]]. Her ovipositor was an immense sac-like organ that could produce an egg roughly every eight [[Time/Legends|seconds]].
